name: octen
description: Real-time web search, news, business lookup, image and video search, and URL extraction for coding agents, powered by Octen.

interface.longDescription:
Octen gives ChatGPT and Codex live information from the web — real-time search infrastructure built for AI.

- Web search: ranked results with query-relevant highlights and clean full content — token-efficient and LLM-ready, no crawling or parsing needed. Minute-level index freshness (second-level for fast-moving data like stock prices and live sports), average latency as low as 62 ms, and sites in 100+ languages.
- News search: headlines and recent events, returned as articles and as storylines — the coverage grouped into subjects with summaries and time spans.
- Business search: a company or a person as a structured card — profile, financials, key people, career history, recent announcements — alongside the sources.
- Broad search: fans one question into multiple concurrent searches for research, comparisons, and landscape surveys.
- URL extract: turns 1-20 URLs into clean markdown for reading, summarizing, and grounding answers.
- Image search: find images by a text query or a reference image.
- Beta (invite-only): video search, with the matched segment's timestamps.

Ask it to look something up, compare options with cited sources, read a page, or profile a company before a meeting.

Requires an OCTEN_API_KEY from https://octen.ai. The video skill additionally requires invite-only beta access (contact support@octen.ai).
defaultPrompt: Use Octen to look up the latest news on this topic.
Use Octen to compare the main options and cite sources.
Use Octen to read this URL and summarize it.
